newsitem.title: GREECE: Pouliadis plans three-for-10 bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Pouliadis plans three-for-10 bonus issue.

text.p: Greek information technology listing Pouliadis will seek shareholder approval for a three-for-10 scrip issue at its forthcoming annual general assembly, it said in a statement on Tuesday.
Pouliadis plans to capitalise reserves amounting to 175 million drachmas, issuing 1,725,000 new common bearer shares.
Pre-tax earnings rose 30.8 percent to 1.194 billion drachmas on turnover growth of 30 percent to over 22 billion drachmas.
Management sees turnover reaching 30 billion drachmas in 1997 and exceeding 40 billion on a consolidated basis.
Its 1996 results matched its turnover and earnings forecasts in its March 1996 IPO prospectus.

The IPO prospectus projected earnings of 1.183 billion drachmas on turnover of 22 billion for fiscal 1996. Pre-tax earnings were projected to reach 1.6 billion drachmas in 1997 on turnover of 30 billion.
Pouliadis will distribute a dividend per share of 110 drachmas for fiscal 1996 versus 58 a year earlier, it said.
Its shares were off 65 drachmas to close at 2,280 on Tuesday in thin trade. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
